ARIFA NAZRIN N

AI DEVELOPER (COPILOT STUDIO)


Kozhikode, Kerala
Email: arifanazrinn@gmail.com | Phone: 7558916703

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

AI Developer with around 4 years of experience. Career started as a Data Engineer specializing in Looker, BigQuery, Airflow, and Python on Google Cloud Platform. Strong experience in building scalable dashboards, automating workflows, and developing end-to-end data pipelines.

Recently worked on building and deploying AI chatbots using Microsoft Copilot Studio, including multi-agent architecture and integrations with OCR, LLM, NLP, API services, and Graph API. Experienced in implementation, testing, live performance monitoring, and continuous improvement of AI applications.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

TATA Consultancy Services Pvt Ltd – Kochi
July 2022 – January 2026

GCP Data Engineer (Walmart, Canada)

Migrated 20+ Apache Hive DAGs to BigQuery in Dev and QA environments
- Updated DAGs for DPASS upgrades
- Performed end-to-end QA validation to ensure production reliability

Looker Developer (UPS US & Woolworths Australia)

Built and optimized dashboards using LookML and BigQuery
- Translated business requirements into efficient SQL and LookML
- Improved performance and accuracy through query tuning

AI Developer (Damen Shipyard, Netherlands)

Developed an AI assistant chatbot using Microsoft Copilot Studio
- Extracted data from multiple unstructured documents
- Automated conversion of extracted data into standardized Stibo step sheets
- Reduced manual effort and improved processing speed



TALROP Pvt Ltd – Kochi
Feb 2021 – Dec 2022

Supported 50+ students on Talrop’s Steyp platform
- Resolved doubts related to HTML and CSS
- Strengthened web development fundamentals

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, Dataflow, Dataproc)

SQL

Python

Apache Airflow (DAGs)

Looker (LookML)

Microsoft Copilot Studio

Azure OpenAI

Graph API

LLM, NLP, Agentic AI

Machine Learning / Deep Learning

CERTIFICATIONS & ACHIEVEMENTS

Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900)
Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer (ACE)
Google Cloud Skill Boost – Diamond League
Analyze and Visualize Looker Data Skill Badge

EDUCATION

Master of Computer Application (2019 – 2022)
Cochin University of Science and Technology

Bachelor of Computer Science (2016 – 2019)
University of Calicut

ACADEMIC PROJECTS

TB Bacilli Detection – CNN model using TensorFlow and NumPy
Heart Disease Predictor – Flask web application using ML models
